procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_270 ('Walthall County 2026 GENERAL ELECTION' banner -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/walthal/; the SoS carries the county's file as 'Walthal_County_2026_general.pdf', one L -- resolved by county_pdf's unique-prefix fallback). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (15/15).
structure_note: Same 7-page-shape-compact five-page form: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 20 precincts (11 columns, then Mesa/Midway/North Kirklin/North Knox/Sartinsville/South Kirklin/St Paul/Varnel/West Tylertown + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House 3, CoA 4, and Chancery 10's Places 1-3; p4+p5 = table B over the same column split carrying Chancery 10 Place 4 and Circuit 15's Places 1-3 and the local rows. Walthall's House district is US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District (the House 3 roster). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District (Michael A. Chiaradio, Michael Guest, Erik Klehle -- the House 3 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty -- the CoA 4 roster, name identical); Chancery Court 10-Chancery District 10 Place 1 (Renee McBride Porter), Place 2 (Rhea Hudson Sheldon), Place 3 (Tara Kellar), Place 4 (Chad Smith, p4) -- the same Chancery 10 roster Lamar/Marion print, names identical; Circuit Court 15-Circuit District 15 Place 1 (Brad A. Touchstone), Place 2 (Ryan Bruhl, Prentiss G. Harrell), Place 3 (Richelle Lumpkin) -- the same Circuit 15 roster Lamar and Marion print, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 2398, Hyde-Smith 2810, Pinkins 88, Chiaradio 2237, Guest 2987, Klehle 47, McCarty 3865, Porter 3891, Sheldon 3756, Kellar 3769, Chad Smith 3857, Touchstone 3780, Bruhl 3744, Harrell 1091, Lumpkin 3747.
operator_rows_note: All 15 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3 cells + the p3 printed TOTAL; the Place 4 and Circuit 15 rows carry p4+p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twenty precinct headers print complete (3rd District Tylertown, '4th District West Tylertown', 4th District Tylertown, Darbun, Dexter, Dinan, East Tylertown, Enon, Hope, Improve, Lexie, Mesa, Midway, North Kirklin, North Knox, Sartinsville, South Kirklin, 'St Paul', Varnel, West Tylertown -- the sheet's own district-precinct forms kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 15 Place 3: 'District 3-Election Commissioner' (Alisa R. Leggett, X-celled outside 3rd District Tylertown/Dexter/Knox) and 'District Five-School Board Member' (Rose Lea Thornton-Wells, X-celled outside South Kirklin/Varnel) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 10's four Places and Circuit 15's three Places print in-county, so the families write Place-qualified labels (matching the other Chancery 10 and Circuit 15 counties).
